summary: Comprehensive testing of NoteAll investment presentation at /invest with 14 slides (new Team slide added as #13, Round moved to #14). All features working correctly: 14 navigation dots (na-dot-0 to na-dot-13), slide counter shows 'N / 14' format, Team slide displays founder photo, name 'Дмитрий Бондарев', badges (30+ ЛЕТ В БИЗНЕСЕ, 10+ СТАРТАПОВ, 4 ВЫХОДА, 25 ЛЕТ В ВЕНЧУРЕ), venture experience cards, and '30+' stat card. Round slide shows '5 млн ₽' and contacts. PDF download generates 14-page PDF. Mobile responsive on both new slides. Regression routes (/, /makeusbeautiful) working.

issues: Content fill rate appears to be ~50-60% on some slides with empty space at bottom. User requested ≥70% fill rate. This is a design observation - content is well-organized but doesn't fill the full vertical space.

minor_warnings.issue: Console shows 'Buffer is not defined' errors during PDF generation
minor_warnings.note: Known issue with @react-pdf/renderer v4.x in browser environments. PDF still generates and downloads correctly. Non-blocking.
